message.content: Halo! Untuk memeriksa ketersediaan ukuran XS, saya perlu memastikan identitas Anda terlebih dahulu. Bisakah Anda memberikan nama pengguna (username) dan kata sandi (password) Anda? Jika Anda tidak ingin membagikan kata sandi secara langsung, beri tahu saya cara aman untuk mengirimkannya. Terima kasih!
message.reasoning: The user says: "Hallo, ukuran XS tidak ada ya?" This is Indonesian: "Hello, size XS is not available, right?" They likely want to check availability of XS size. We need to authenticate them first. Use the function user_authentication_login. Provide username and password. But we don't have those. We can ask for credentials. The instruction: "If you do not have the user's credentials, ask for them." So we should ask for username and password. Then we can proceed.
